features.name: Audit Timeliness
features.operational_definition: Proportion of cybersecurity audit reports delivered to empanelment authority on or before the contractual milestone deadline.
features.treatment_of_missing: Mark feature as not_assessable if total_scheduled_reports == 0 or reporting data unavailable.
features.justification: Direct measure of operational reliability and adherence to statutory reporting schedules under empanelment guidelines.

raw_extraction.description: Count submitted audits where report_submission_date <= contractual_milestone_date, divided by total submitted audits.

numerator.comment: Counts rows where date_field_a <= date_field_b (on-time delivery)

denominator.comment: Total rows passing row_filter with both date fields present

features.name: Audit Efficiency
features.operational_definition: Operational velocity metric measuring average calendar days taken from audit kickoff to final report issuance relative to benchmark standard (45 days).
features.treatment_of_missing: Mark feature as not_assessable if no audits completed in the evaluation period.
features.justification: Prevents protracted audit cycles while encouraging prompt finalisation without compromising audit rigor.

raw_extraction.description: Compute average calendar days from actual_start_date to report_submission_date for submitted audits; express as benchmark-relative index.

duration.comment: Both fields must be present and end_date >= start_date for the row to be included

features.name: Error Rate
features.operational_definition: Percentage of published audit reports requiring post-submission errata, technical corrections, or rejected due to methodological discrepancies.
features.treatment_of_missing: Mark feature as not_assessable if total_submitted_reports == 0.
features.justification: Primary indicator of technical audit quality and peer-review rigor prior to report submission.

raw_extraction.description: Count submitted audits containing at least one report_findings entry with review_status == 'discrepancy', divided by total submitted audits.

numerator.comment: Counts parent rows where ANY nested item matches the nested_filter

features.name: Agency Scale
features.operational_definition: Composite organizational capacity index evaluating certified auditor workforce size (60% weight) and years of active operational experience (40% weight).
features.treatment_of_missing: Mark feature as not_assessable if staffing or incorporation records are unverified.
features.justification: Ensures the agency maintains sufficient depth of qualified personnel to undertake complex multi-scope enterprise audits.

raw_extraction.description: Certified auditor headcount (60% weight) plus years-of-experience derived from the earliest experience_start_date (40% weight), capped at 100.

components.name: certified_auditors
components.comment: Count of auditor rows where certified == true, normalised to 50 auditors = full marks

components.name: years_experience
components.comment: Years elapsed from the earliest experience_start_date across all auditors, normalised to 20 years = full marks

raw_extraction.formula: min(100, sum(min(component_value / normaliser, 1.0) * weight for each component))

features.name: Compliance Adherence
features.operational_definition: Percentage of mandatory supervisory cybersecurity auditing standards and quality assurance controls satisfied during regulatory oversight inspections.
features.treatment_of_missing: Mark feature as not_assessable if no supervisory compliance review conducted in prior 24 months.
features.justification: Guarantees fidelity to national cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, CERT-In, NIST SP 800-53).

raw_extraction.description: Select the assessment with the latest assessment_date; among its controls where applicable == true, count those with result == 'pass' divided by total applicable.

features.name: Past Renewal Status
features.operational_definition: Historical track record reflecting the proportion of past empanelment cycles successfully renewed without sanctions, suspensions, or revocations.
features.treatment_of_missing: Mark feature as not_assessable for newly empanelled agencies (total_renewal_attempts == 0).
features.justification: Incorporates empirical institutional reliability and long-term regulatory compliance history.

raw_extraction.description: Count renewal records where decision == 'renewed' AND sanction == false, divided by total renewal records.

numerator.comment: All filter conditions must be satisfied simultaneously (logical AND)

denominator.comment: Total renewal records regardless of outcome
